Replace diagnostic red/white skin dithering with coherent peach fills. Preserve each hand attachment and the hidden far-side anatomy; do not add extra limbs or expose hidden eyes. Her green tail curls down around the supporting hands then up the right edge ending in fin lobes at mid-right height. Johnny low-left with top hat seen from side/back, dark coat below, head close to her waist/shoulder. He holds her waist/base of tail; the nearer supporting hand contacts tail below.
